changelog: 🛠️ A round of fixes. After a batch action, Clear filters, dismissing a new key or a token refresh, keyboard focus stays where you were instead of jumping to the top of the page. The Add account button shows its focus ring in both themes, the update dialog keeps its buttons on screen on short windows, and times read "1 hour ago" instead of "60 minutes ago". Account tests name the proxy they really used, and 2FA recovery codes download reliably.
